tts: This program keeps five days of blood sugar readings in one list, then picks readings out by their position.
The comment says what the numbers are: fasting blood sugar, in milligrams per decilitre.
Square brackets make a list. sugar now holds five numbers, in the order they were written.
sugar of zero is the first reading. Python counts positions from zero, so this is one hundred and ten.
Minus one counts from the end, so sugar of minus one is the last reading: one hundred and five.
The slice one to four starts at position one and stops just before position four. That gives three readings.
len counts the items in the list: five readings.
